name: Veterancy System
description: Red Alert-style veterancy for your gear: sentries rank up from kills during a mission (Veteran, then Elite) and reset at its end: the Mortar, Gas Mortar, Gatling, Machine Gun and Laser Sentries, and a shared gas doctrine fed by every gas kill. Settings in field-promotions.ini. Includes promotion banners and rank badges on the stratagem list (needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime; the mod works without them). Rank badges use code / research from HD2Runtime by SkyeShade: https://github.com/SkyeShade/HD2Runtime
